title: Cleansing and Selection of the Levites
description: The Lord commands Moses to cleanse the Levites by sprinkling them with water for cleansing, shaving them, and having them wash their clothes before presenting them to the assembly. The Israelites lay their hands on the Levites, and Aaron presents them as a wave offering to the Lord. The Levites are taken in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites and given as a gift to Aaron and his sons to serve in the tent of meeting and make atonement for the people.
